aboutPages.title: Empowering Academic Excellence Across Bangladesh
aboutPages.subtitle: Built by students for students — eliminating ghosting, fraud, and poor grades with bank-grade escrow, verified campus peers, and authentic handwriting matching.
aboutPages.para1: Every semester, tens of thousands of university students in Bangladesh face grueling workloads across complex engineering lab reports, calculus problem sets, and massive handwritten term papers.
aboutPages.para2: Until now, students relied on unregulated Facebook groups where fraud was rampant: advance payments were stolen, ghost helpers vanished before deadlines, and handwritten notes looked completely foreign.
aboutPages.para3: KoreDao was engineered to change this forever. By introducing a formal dual freelance marketplace with 100% escrow protection, student ID card verification, and progressive milestone progress scans, we protect both students and hard-working peer helpers.
aboutPages.zeroLossBold: Payments stay in escrow and are only released after student approval.
aboutPages.authenticHandwritingBold: Verified samples showcase loops, neatness, and math formulas.
aboutPages.campusProximityBold: In-person delivery at Curzon Hall, Palashi, Merul Badda & more.
aboutPages.zeroLeakageBold: Keeps student identity confidential and prevents off-platform scams.
